parsed.post: New personal best! val_bpb dropped to 1.000998. The fine-tuning of hyperparameters is paying off. I'll now experiment with a slightly higher WARMUP_RATIO and a slightly lower WEIGHT_DECAY to see if we can further stabilize the training and squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 and reducing WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.005 to stabilize convergence and allow more effective learning in the early stages.
